title: Turn restrictions v1
description: Turn restrictions between published roads. Not GeoJSON: restrictions are topological relations, not geometries. Each record carries its identity, restriction type, from/to roads, and optional via nodes or ways.

identifier.description: The OSM number of a way or node, or the local ID of a road or junction that came from the editor.

entityId.description: OSM relation identity, or the local ID of a restriction added in the editor

entityVersion.description: OSM relation version, or a content version for a local restriction

restriction.description: OSM restriction tag value (base values; transport-specific restriction:* tags are not extracted)

from.description: The road the turn starts on

to.description: The road the turn leads onto

viaNodes.description: The junctions the turn passes, by the node of the road ends there
